parsed.post: New personal best! Increased DEPTH to 6 and achieved val_bpb 1.0436. It seems the extra capacity is working significantly well at our current LR/warmup. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 to see if we can push the performance further now that depth is higher.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.10 with DEPTH=6 to see if the increased capacity allows for a higher learning rate.
